(a) Pinus plant is branched
True – Pinus is a branched tree with a taproot, and it shows dimorphic branches (long and dwarf shoots).
(b) Cycas plant is dioecious
True – Cycas has separate male and female plants.
(c) In gymnosperm, the male and female gametophytes do not have an independent free-living existence
True – In gymnosperms, both male and female gametophytes are dependent on the sporophyte, and do not live independently.
Final answer : 2"
